name: Tarzan
desc: Tree climb, old access to 'Humanality'.
setter: Sam Lightner, Gerd Schöffl & Volker Schöffl, 1993

name: Eviction
desc: All titanium bolts (P1: 12 bolts, P2: 7 bolts).

name: Eviction (Variation)
desc: Splits to the left about halfway up P1. All titanium bolts (P1: 9 bolts, P2: 7 bolts).

name: Bird's Nest Drop
desc: Access by the first pitch of 'Humanality'. Then left of P2. Old stainless steel glue-in bolts. Do not climb!

name: Humanality
desc: Could be 5, 6 or 7 piches, depending how you see the climb. Start up the ladder, left of 'Cowabungalow'. Climb up behind a stalactite and traverse left to the anchor on the ledge. 1 titanium bolt, 4 slings. Straight up the stalactite and right to the anchor on the cave of the next ledge. 4 titanium bolts. Traverse outwards to the right. Straight up on the face. Anchor to the left on a small ledge above the 'Bird's Nest Drop' anchor. 5 titanium bolts, 2 slings. Straight up into the tufas to a big belay ledge. 7 titanium bolts, 2 slings. Up and right under the big stalactite formation. 6 titanium bolts, 5 slings. Up the wall to the right of a big structure. 3 titanium bolts, 4 slings. Old pitch that traverses left on threads. Dangerous and never climbed. With a single 60m rope, it's one short rappel from the top of pitch 6 to the top of pitch 5, then three raps to separate abseil anchors. If you have a 70m rope, you can rap straight from the top of pitch 6 to the next set of anchors.

name: Human Frality
desc: Trad climb, which was used to open 'Humanality'.

name: Open Project
desc: Unfinished project on the short wall below P1 of 'Humanality'. About 8a or higher. Now behind the small shack right of the Freedom Bar.

name: Planet Ton Sai
desc: On the short wall below P1 of 'Humanality', now covered by the small shack right of the Freedom Bar.

name: I No Speak England
desc: Starts at the platform of the Freedom Bar. Crux is right at the start. 5 stainless steel glue-in bolts, 6 slings. Stick-clip the 2nd bolt to avoid hitting the platform on a lead fall!

name: Cowabungalow
desc: The leftmost line on the terrace right of 'Humanality'. All titanium bolts.

name: Super Liam
desc: Shares the start with 'Cowabungalow', then right towards the small cave. Be careful with loose rock in the upper part. 5 titanium bolts, 2 slings.

name: Sweating Mekong
desc: Short crux about halfway. All titanium bolts.

name: Viking in Heat
desc: Head up the ladder then straight up the wall, which gets increasingly overhanging. 6 titanium bolts, 1 sling.

name: Ya Rup Rup
desc: Squeezed just right of 'Viking in Heat'. All titanium bolts.

name: Hin Rong Hai
desc: Do not skip the crux by going right towards the anchor -- only 6b then and risk of breaking the fragile tufas. All titanium bolts.

name: Big Guy Loosing the Cat
desc: The leftmost line on the upper terrace. Shares anchors with 'Silkcat'. 3 titanium bolts, 2 slings.

name: Silkcat
desc: Shares the first two clips with 'Tom Yum' and anchors with 'Big Guy Loosing the Cat'. 2 titanium bolts, 2 slings.

name: Tom Yum
desc: Big moves on big holds. Getting polished, but still worth climbing. Shares the first two clips with 'Silkcat', then up right. 3 titanium bolts, 1 sling.

name: Trade Winds
desc: 5 titanium bolts, 1 sling.

name: Dry Net
desc: All titanium bolts.

name: On the Terrace
desc: Starts on the very right edge of the upper terrace. Start is a little hard to read. 5 titanium bolts, 4 slings.

name: For You & For Me
desc: Crawling through the corner on the very left side of the roof. 1 titanium bolts, 6 slings. Careful, anchors not equipped with rings. Do not lower through the slings!

name: Riesenbaby
desc: Stiff start up to the cauliflower, then traverses right on the rails. Nice moves, though very polished. All titanium bolts.
setter: Sam Lightner, Gerd Schöffl & Volker Schöffl, 1993

name: Spanish Wreck
desc: Warning Flora and Fauna: Wasps/Hornets Shares anchors with 'Dragon Ball' and 'Old Chicken Makes a Good Soup'. All titanium bolts.

name: Dragon Ball
desc: Very Dynamic climbing. Good fun! Shares anchors with 'Spanish Wreck' and 'Old Chicken Makes a Good Soup'. All titanium bolts.

name: Old Chicken Makes a Good Soup
desc: Original grade 8a. Upgraded after breakage of a stalactite. Shares anchors with 'Spanish Wreck' and 'Dragon Ball'. 6 titanium bolts, 1 sling.

name: Hang Ten
desc: Original grade 7c. Upgraded after breakage of a stalactite in 2006. All titanium bolts.

name: Tidal Wave
desc: Very popular and very polished, short and powerful with a tendency to spit you off with sloppy beta. Make sure your belayer is paying attention otherwise you could end up with a mouth full of sand. All titanium bolts.

name: Baby Gorilla
desc: Original grade 7b+. Upgraded due to a broken hold. Titanium bolts.

name: Sunrise West Way
desc: Old stainless steel glue-in bolts. Do not climb!

name: Angle Couple
desc: Old stainless steel glue-in bolts. Do not climb!

name: Tantrum
desc: The Tonsai beach classic! Get on it. All titanium bolts.

name: World Peace
desc: Closed Old route just left of 'Cafe Andaman', sharing the top section with 'Tantrum'. this is a dumb line of bolts with no holds.
warnings: Closed Old route just left of 'Cafe Andaman', sharing the top section with 'Tantrum'.

name: Cafe Tantrum
desc: Linkup. Start with 'Cafe Andaman', then continue on the traverse and finish on the anchors of 'Tantrum'.

name: Café Andaman
desc: Climbs straight up the obvious tufa, then traverses left. Finishes in the small cave next to the anchor. Top section can seep after rain. Titanium bolts.

name: Ton Sai Love Story
desc: Old route, sharing the start with 'Ton Sai Playboy', but going up into the left roof after the 3rd clip. Rusty expansion bolts, anchors seem to have been removed. Cannot be climbed anymore.
warnings: Rusty expansion bolts, anchors seem to have been removed.

name: Ton Sai Playboy
desc: Very popular, easy start to pumpy roof climbing. Just keep moving all the way to the anchors! Very fun! A bit harder now, after holds broke recently. Take the left line after the fourth bolt, or you end up in 'Playboy Connection'. Titanium bolts and slings.

name: Playboy Connection
desc: Linkup. Start at 'Ton Sai Playboy' and continue right after 4th bolt to join 'Mafia Connection'. Often confused with 'Tonsai Playboy' as this route is missing in most guidebooks. All titanium bolts.

name: Mafia Connection
desc: Starts just left of 'Love for Travelling', finishes on the anchor just right of 'Ton Sai Playboy'. Tricky start, pumpy finish. 5 titanium bolts, 1 sling.

name: Mafia Lover
desc: Linkup. Finish variation after the early crux. Veers right after the 3rd bolt and joins 'Love for Travelling' just below the small roof. All titanium bolts.

name: Love for Travelling
desc: Very nice line that, for some reason, gets much less attention than the popular and always busy 'Lal Bab' or 'Babes in Thailand', although it is just as good. A bit of an awkward stemming start to get onto the thick stalactite. Then some nice 3D climbing, which is easier than it looks once you've sorted out the beta. All titanium bolts.

name: Just Dusit
desc: Shares the first bolt with 'Germans in Tights', then left. All titanium bolts.

name: Germans in Tights
desc: Shares the first bolt with 'Just Dusit', then right. All titanium bolts.

name: Second Home Ton Sai
desc: Another great line that is often overlooked and sees by far not as much traffic as many of the "classics" in the roof. Bouldery start, then fight the pump to the anchors. All titanium bolts.

name: Beauty and the Beast
desc: Closed The route has been closed and the crux bolts removed (see comments). The original description is preserved for posterity: Awesome route !!! A little bit psycho when you must fall on the tufa. Seems to be 6c for people under 1.70m, for the other 6a+. But, you should do this route!!!
warnings: Closed The route has been closed and the crux bolts removed (see comments).

name: Stalagasaurus
desc: Original grade 6a+. Upgraded after breakage of a huge stalactite in 2004. Good climbing apart from the broken section, which wrecks the flow. Still fun and still worth it. 6 titanium bolts, 1 sling.

name: Babes in Thailand
desc: Popular climb on pinches and jugs. All titanium bolts.

name: Sex Power
desc: All titanium bolts.

name: Lal Bab
desc: Early crux, followed by big powerful moves on jugs in the first half, then much easier and less steep to the top. All titanium bolts.

name: Elephant
desc: 4 titanium bolts, 1 sling.

name: Banshee
desc: Shares anchors with 'Cream of Tom Yum Kai'.

name: Cream of Tom Yum Kai
desc: Too much fun for one climb. All titanium bolts.

name: Ant Jump
desc: All titanium bolts.

name: Voodoo Doll
desc: All titanium bolts.

name: Phet Maak
desc: A real classic of the area. Originally graded 8a and still is if you go direct, nowadays most people head out right to the large tufa midway essentially avoiding the crux. All titanium bolts.

name: Cara Cangreso
desc: All titanium bolts. Shares anchors with 'Czech Open'.

name: Czech Open
desc: Start variation to the right of 'Cara Cangreso' and share anchor. Joins on the headwall. All titanium bolts.

name: Gaeng Som Pla
desc: Another Tonsai beach classic! Starts on the crack right of 'Czech Open'. All titanium bolts.

name: Down Flyer
desc: Starts 5m right of 'Gaeng Som Pla', straight through the steep grey roof into the structured rock below the anchor. 5 titanium bolts, 1 sling.

name: Speak No Evil
desc: Traverse following the crack and the ledge on the roof. All titanium bolts.
setter: Björn Alber, Nantawan Alber & Robert Baier, 2010

name: Kun Suk Khoo
desc: Traverses left along the upper crack in the roof, right and above 'Speak no Evil'. All titanium bolts.
setter: Ymer Alber, Björn Alber & Henrik Bolander, 2015

name: First Blood
desc: The furthest line to right behind the bushes. Traverses left along the edge of the roof. All titanium bolts.

name: Sex C Plus
desc: Closed

name: Scary Skinny Iguana
desc: Closed

name: Secret Jam
desc: Closed

name: Left Break
desc: Closed

name: Honeycomb Hole
desc: Closed

name: Durian Thorn
desc: Closed

name: Full Crimp Milk
desc: Leftmost line, short and bouldery. Shares anchors with 'Wadumori'. All titanium bolts.

name: Wadumori
desc: Shares anchors with 'Full Crimp Milk'. All titanium bolts.

name: Society of Gravitational Studies
desc: All titanium bolts.
setter: Sam Lightner, Gerd Schöffl & Volker Schöffl, 1993

name: Mama Zu
desc: The steep face right of 'Society of Gravitational Studies'. Stainless steel glue-in bolts.

name: Arts & Sport
desc: Shares the start with 'Wake & Bake', then left onto the face. All titanium bolts.
setter: Sam Lightner, Gerd Schöffl & Volker Schöffl, 1993

name: Wake & Bake
desc: Climbs the obvious corner crack. Shares anchors with 'By Way of Deception'. All titanium bolts.

name: By Way of Deception
desc: Warning Flora and Fauna: Wasps/Hornets Starts right of the 'Wake & Bake' corner, shares the same anchor. Original start is hidden behind the shack. All titanium bolts.

name: Jugs for Jumping
desc: Shares the start with 'Jumping for Jugs', then left.
setter: Ghop The Rockshop, Maxi Montree & Zak Zakariya, 2021

name: Jumping for Jugs
desc: As the name suggests, jump for the jug to start. All titanium bolts.

name: Nair Nawn
desc: Shares the start with 'Jumping for Jugs', then right to the anchor of 'Fips, der Affe'. 5 titanium bolts, 1 sling.

name: Fips, der Affe
desc: Shares the first meters into the corner with 'The Day After', then left over the bulge to a technical balancy finish. Shares the anchor with 'Nair Nawn'. 2 titanium bolts, 4 slings.

name: The Day After
desc: Shares the start with 'Fips, der Affe', then straight up, sharing anchors with 'No Onion, No Garlic'. 4 titanium bolts, 2 slings.

name: No Onion, No Garlic
desc: Warning Fixed Gear: Old slings Up the tufas, then left to a pumpy finish. Shares the last two clips and anchors with 'The Day After'. 4 titanium bolts, 4 slings.

name: Aunt Mary Johanna & Two Girls
desc: Closed Old bolts and slings, overgrown. Cannot be climbed anymore.
warnings: Closed Old bolts and slings, overgrown.

name: No Name
desc: Pumpy start through the overhang left of 'Schlingel Max'. Easier finish. 1 titanium bolt, 4 slings.

name: Son Thoi
desc: Share start with 'Schlingel Max', then turn left to anchor of 'No Name'.

name: Schlingel Max
desc: Interesting crux on polished rock. 5 titanium bolts, 1 sling.

name: Don Quijote de la Mancha
desc: Starts just left of 'Schlingel Moritz'. Technical start, easy middle section and a big move above the bulge. Don't cheat at the start by going too far right. All titanium bolts.

name: Schlingal Moritz
desc: Warning Fixed Gear: The rope sheath at the top anchor was damaged Hard start for the grade, especially when you're short. All titanium bolts.
warnings: Fixed Gear: The rope sheath at the top anchor was damaged

name: Good Medicine
desc: One pockety tough crux towards the middle, then smooth sailing - top is a beautiful and much easier slab. All titanium bolts.
setter: Björn Alber, Nantawan Alber & Robert Baier, 2006

name: Reminiscence
desc: A true Tonsai beach classic. Starts on the tufas right of 'Good Medicine'. 8 titanium, 1 expansion bolt.

name: Maxi's Project
desc: Squeezed in on the steep featureless rock between 'Reminiscence' and 'Mai Mee Fahn'.

name: Mai Mee Fahn
desc: Hard crux right at the start to get up to the tufas. Afterwards easier, but continuous. Reachy both at the start and towards the anchor. All titanium bolts.

name: Avocado Power
desc: All titanium bolts.

name: The Lion King
desc: Climbs around the prominent flake with insanely polished feet. Though the crux awaits right before the anchor. All titanium bolts.
setter: Volker Schöffl, Melanie Schöffl & Sam Lightner, 1996

name: The Tiger Queen
desc: Easy start towards a crimpy crux. All titanium bolts.

name: Thai Taam Nean
desc: Project about 8b, though only bolted with expansion bolts.

name: Storm in Head
desc: Extension of 'Thai Tham Nean'. Also only expansion bolts.

name: Jai Dum
desc: An amazing line linking a series of small flakes up the beautiful orange wall. All titanium bolts.

name: Of Popes and Power
desc: All titanium bolts.

name: Greed
desc: Currently the hardest ascent in Thailand. ‘It’s On’ from start to finish. Phenomenal climbing. All titanium bolts.

name: Hot Springs
desc: Broken hold, needs repairs and rebolting. Protected by expansion bolts.

name: Asia Shadow Play
desc: Starts up the stairs towards 'Tyrolean Wall'. Shares the first few meters with 'The Sit Spins', then straight up. All titanium bolts.
setter: Sam Lightner, Gerd Schöffl & Volker Schöffl, 1994

name: The Sit Spins
desc: Shares the start with 'Asia Shadow Play'. Traverses right, then up along the crack. Be careful, the crux just above the ledge is badly protected. All titanium bolts.
setter: Sam Lightner, Gerd Schöffl & Volker Schöffl, 1995

name: The Sit Spins (Direct Start)
desc: Direct start to 'The Sit Spins'. Starts on 4 slings to cut off traversing, just on the very left of 'Tyrolean Wall'. Face climb on small holds with a big move to reach the ledge.

name: The Sit Spins (Extension)
desc: Extension of 'The Sit Spins' or 'Remix Direct'. Goes to the top of the wall. Great endurance climbing with an interesting finale. Titanium bolts. Anchors need new titanium circular ring and new rope.

name: The Wrath of Nantawan
desc: The leftmost line on 'Tyrolean Wall'. Don't confuse with 'Remix Direct', which starts on the very left of the wall, but is assigned to 'Dum's Kitchen'. All titanium bolts.
setter: Björn Alber, Mon Alber & Robert Baier, 2008

name: Placebo
desc: Endurance climb with a stiff crux over the bulge. All titanium bolts.
setter: Björn Alber, Mon Alber & Robert Baier, 2008

name: Loisl
desc: Hard for the grade. Consider stick-clipping the first bolt. All titanium bolts.

name: Missing Snow
desc: Great climbing, but very popular and polished. Bouldery move to easy climbing and ridiculous tubular jugs. Left and up, Choose your own adventure from here to anchors at the cave. All titanium bolts.

name: Schwer und Steil
desc: Now bolted. Thin start, be careful. Crimps to the crux. Keep enough in the tank for the end. All titanium bolts.

name: Pavel, Wish You Were Here
desc: First pitch is 'Schwer und Steil'. All pitches bolted with titanium bolts.
setter: Alex Klenov, A Celishev & V Skripka, 2011

name: Longes Feschtl
desc: All titanium bolts. Share anchor with Kuahtittnseppl.

name: Kuahtittnseppl
desc: All titanium bolts. Share anchor with Longes Feschtl.

name: Tricky Business
desc: All titanium bolts.

name: K1
desc: All titanium bolts.

name: Tyrolean Air
desc: Classic. All titanium bolts.

name: The Zephyr
desc: All titanium bolts.

name: No Have
desc: All titanium bolts. Share anchor with Just Call Me Helmet.

name: Just Call Me Helmet
desc: All titanium bolts. Share anchor with No Have.

name: Blind, Deaf and Dumb
desc: Shares the first clip with 'Just Call Me Helmet', then right. All titanium bolts.
setter: James Lombard, Ill Amstutz & Steve Amstutz, 2003

name: Affentanz
desc: Starts about 30m further to the right along the trail. Shares three bolts with 'Lars & Lars', then left. 9 titanium bolts, 1 sling.

name: Lars & Lars
desc: Balancy and bold. Shares the start with 'Affentanz', then straight up. All titanium bolts.

name: The White Crow
setter: Maxi Montree, Hari Pongsopen & Ghop Pongsopon, 2023

name: Hammer Operation
setter: Zak Zakariya, Hari Pongsopen & Ghop Pongsopon, 2023

name: The Sloperment
desc: Shares second part and anchor with 'Hammer Operation'. All titanium bolts.

name: Tyrosine
desc: Horribly chipped route. High 2nd bolt. Starts next to a tree. Using the tree lowers the grade.
setter: Zak Zakariya, Hari Pongsopen & Ghop Pongsopon, 2023

name: Mind over Matter
desc: All titanium bolts.

name: The Rose
desc: All titanium bolts.

name: The Rose (Extension)
desc: Open project, about 8b. Protected by slings.

name: Finger Bang Bang
desc: 8 titanium bolts, 1 sling.

name: Face Plant
desc: All titanium bolts. 1st pitch of 35 Stitches.

name: 35 Stitches
desc: Two-bolt extension of 'Face Plant'. All titanium bolts.

name: Year of the Tiger
desc: A classic multi pitch. All pitches bolted with titanium glue-ins. Starts just right of 'Face Plant', then traverses right. All titanium bolts.
setter: Sam Lightner, Scott Morley & Nancy Feagin, 1993

name: Home of The Lost Turtles
desc: Shares anchor with 'Gun Solo'. All titanium bolts.

name: Gun Solo
desc: Shares anchor with 'Home of The Lost Turtles'. All titanium bolts.

name: Tear of the Liger
desc: Starts a little bit further right around the vegetated part of the wall. 10 titanium bolts, 1 sling.

name: Bugger Your Neighbour
desc: Trad climb (E2, E5, E5, E4, E6), starting on the very right of 'Tiger Wall', into the obvious corner. See the 'Thailand and Laos Rock Climbing Guidebook' by Elke Schmitz (Basecamp Ton Sai) for a complete description.

name: Mai Rhu Sheu!
desc: Around the corner, 20m left of 'Plausible Deniability'. Loose rock, old rusty expansion bolts. Do not climb!
warnings: Loose rock, old rusty expansion bolts.

name: Australian Invasion
desc: 6 titanium bolts, 1 sling.

name: Asian Invasion
desc: Shares the first three bolts with 'Australian Invasion', then goes a bit to the right under the roof.

name: Made in Spain
desc: Up a sharp slab, following the seam to the top. 3 titanium bolts, 3 slings.

name: Can You Fix It?
desc: Assigned grades vary between 6a-6b+ in different guidebooks. 6b+ according to the latest Basecamp update (2025). 6a according to the route setters. Route finding/route reading essential to make it 6a. Maybe it is a 6a for the redpoint and 6b as an onsight.

name: No It's Broken
desc: Assigned grades vary between 6a-6b in different guidebooks. 6b according to the latest Basecamp update (2025). 6a according to the route setters. Route finding/route reading essential to make it 6a. Maybe it is a 6a for the redpoint and 6a+ as an onsight.

name: Perfectly Imperfect
desc: 40m pitch - watch the end of your rope!

name: Dead Spanish Bolts
desc: Climbs the obvious corner left of the belay ledge. All titanium bolts.

name: Spiderman
desc: The lefthand route on the small belay ledge, accessed by climbing up the fixed rope. 6 titanium bolts, 5 slings. With an 80m rope you can belay from below. You need 17 quickdraws.

name: Into the Spiderverse
desc: Second pitch of 'Spiderman', mostly 6a with a 6b/+ ending just before the anchor.

name: Desayuno de Nono
desc: The middle line starting from the belay ledge. Titanium bolts and slings.

name: Desayuno de Nono (Variation)
desc: Finish variation to the right, 5m before the anchor.

name: Alta Ruta
desc: Righthand route on the belay ledge. 4 titanium bolts, 5 slings.

name: Lost in Space
desc: On the wall left of the 'Where Eagles Don't Dare' corner. 3 titanium bolts, 4 slings.

name: Where Eagles Don't Dare
desc: Beautiful through the obvious corner. Nice bridging moves and a rewarding view at the top. 7 titanium bolts, 2 slings.
setter: Wee Changrua, Todd Offenbacher & Mark Miner, 1998

name: Flavour of the Week
desc: Shares the slabby start with 'Where Eagles Don't Dare', then veers right onto the face. 6 titanium bolts, 3 slings.

name: No Name
desc: Start shared with 'Amazing Thailand', then left just before the arête. All titanium bolts.

name: Amazing Thailand
desc: Straight up the overhang, then to technical moves, finishing up at easier grade on the arête. Polished but awesome. All titanium bolts.

name: Sang Trip
desc: All titanium bolts.

name: 5D Mak Mak
desc: All titanium bolts.

name: Yaa Bhar
desc: All titanium bolts. Shares anchors with 'Mentally Deranged in Hiding'.

name: Mentally Deranged in Hiding
desc: 4 titanium bolts, 3 slings. Share anchor with Yaa Bhar.

name: Kuhn Ba
desc: Reachy crux move to get into the tufas. Slightly awkward finish. 4 titanium bolts, 1 sling.

name: Black Hole
desc: Climbs through the big holes on the steep wall left of the cave. All titanium bolts.

name: Totem Pole
desc: Closed Climbed the big column in front of the cave. Bolts have been chopped, because it was not possible to rebolt the route.
warnings: Closed Climbed the big column in front of the cave.

desc: Nice line, but extremely polished. All titanium bolts.
setter: Tom Cecil, Todd Offenbacher & Mark Miner, 1998

name: Afterburner
desc: Three-bolt extension of '4:20'. All titanium bolts.
setter: Tom Cecil, Todd Offenbacher & Mark Miner, 1998

name: Sea Monkeys
desc: Shares the start with '4:20', then right. A bit awkward to exit the overhang. Unfortunate bolt placement at the crux, with the rope getting in your way. 11 titanium bolts, 1 sling.

name: Speaking out Loud
desc: All titanium bolts.

name: The Annihilator
desc: All titanium bolts.

name: Balance Crack
desc: Leftmost line through the obvious corner. Titanium bolts.

name: Out of Line
desc: Shares the start with 'Ann's First Time', then straight up to the left of the three shorter anchors. Titanium bolts.

name: Ann's First Time
desc: Shares the start with 'Out of Line' amd and anchors with 'Sharp Cove'. Titanium bolts.

name: Sharp Cove
desc: Starts with 'Easy Dude', then left and up to the anchors of 'Ann's First Time'. Titanium bolts.

name: Easy Dude
desc: Rightmost start and anchors. Titanium bolts.

name: Cobra Venom
desc: Access by climbing up to the second fixed rope. Shares the start with 'Ngu Baen Vohk', then straight up the roof. 8 titanium bolts, 2 slings.

name: Ngu Baen Vohk
desc: Access by climbing up to the second fixed rope. Shares the start with 'Cobra Venom', then veers right around the arête to steep jugs. 8 titanium bolts, 4 slings.

name: Snake Skin
desc: Use the fixed rope for the belayer. 5 titanium bolts, 6 slings.

name: Cobra Head
desc: Use the fixed rope for the belayer. Titanium bolts and slings.

name: Snake Whisky
desc: Use the fixed rope for the belayer. Titanium bolts and slings.

name: Baby Snake
desc: Warning Rock: Hornets Nest Hard start through the overhang. 3 titanium bolts, 7 slings. Careful, potentially dangerous lead fall!

name: The Last of Its Kind
desc: Climb up in the small roof right of 'Baby Snake'. 2 titanium bolts, 10 slings.

name: Old Snake
desc: Starts on top of the boulder. 4 titanium bolts, 5 slings.

name: The Snake Strikes
desc: Starts about 50m right of 'Old Snake'. Steep and pumpy climbing. Titanium bolts and slings.

name: No Name
setter: Sam Lightner, Gerd Schöffl & Volker Schöffl, 1996

name: S.O.S.
desc: Shares the first pitch with 'Cockroach Beach'. Then veers left after the first anchor. Access either by traversing from below 'Cross Eyed', or by climbing straight up for 20m at about 6a level, A 60m rope is just enough to rappel from the first anchor. All titanium bolts.
setter: Sam Lightner, Gerd Schöffl & Volker Schöffl, 1996

name: Cockroach Beach
desc: Shares the first pitch with 'S.O.S.'. Then straight up after the first anchor. Access either by traversing from below 'Cross Eyed', or by climbing straight up for 20m at about 6a level, A 60m rope is just enough to rappel from the first anchor. All titanium bolts.
setter: Sam Lightner, Gerd Schöffl & Volker Schöffl, 1996

name: Cross Eyed
desc: Long endurance climb. All titanium bolts.

name: Affenhitze
desc: Just as long as 'Cross Eyed', though a bit easier. All titanium bolts.

name: Climb of the Ancient Mariner
desc: Passes two anchors at 6a level, then climbs diagonally left up the overhang getting increasingly difficult. Crosses over 'Affenhitze'. Designed to be climbed in one pitch. All titanium bolts.

name: Climb of the Ancient Mariner P1
desc: Ends at the first anchor.

name: Climb of the Ancient Mariner P2
desc: Extends up behind the big stalactite for about 5m to the second anchor.

name: Captain Hook
desc: Shares the anchor with 'Right Hand of Buddha'. 3 titanium bolts, 2 slings.

name: Right Hand of Buddha
desc: Shares the anchor with 'Captain Hook'. 4 titanium bolts, 1 sling.

name: Melting Pot
desc: Second pitch of either 'Captain Hook' or 'Right Hand of Buddha'. 3 titanium bolts, 1 sling.
setter: Ray Bernard, Ian Turnbull & Alex F, 1996

name: Doing the Trad
desc: Shares the anchor with 'Captain Hook' and 'Right Hand of Buddha' to allow toprope access. Route is now bolted, originally climbed on trad gear.

name: Bonsoir
desc: Easy climbing into the first overhang, reachy crux to get onto the arête. Another reachy move to get to the tufas. 4 titanium bolts, 3 slings.

name: The Smoking Room
desc: Climbs the tufa system on the very right side of the wall. Hard crux for the grade. 5 titanium bolts, 5 slings.

name: Little View Point
desc: Closed Old slings. Do not climb!

name: Panique a Bord
desc: Closed Old slings. Do not climb!

name: Mai Technology
desc: Closed Old slings. Do not climb!

name: Fistrouille Poupouillie
desc: Closed Old slings. Do not climb!

name: La Mano Negra
desc: Closed Old slings. Do not climb!

name: Bouts D'Nouilie
desc: Closed Old slings. Do not climb!

name: Domingo
desc: Closed Alternative second pitch of 'Bouts D'Nouilie'. Old slings. Do not climb!
warnings: Closed Alternative second pitch of 'Bouts D'Nouilie'.

name: Moulin D'Brainant
desc: Closed Old slings. Do not climb!

name: Fakir II the Return
desc: Closed Old slings. Do not climb!

name: Bloody Route
desc: Closed Old slings. Do not climb!

name: Mafiosito Style
desc: Closed Old slings. Do not climb!

name: Pico Pico

name: Tuna Melt

name: Chicken Muscle

name: Chicken Skin

name: Burnt Offerings
desc: Warning Fixed Gear: Rusty quick link on 5th titaniam bolt, who has a grinder 😉 Popular picture location. Located up the hill heading left from the main wall, on the right side of an impressive looking cave. All titanium bolts.
warnings: Fixed Gear: Rusty quick link on 5th titaniam bolt, who has a grinder 😉

name: Sinister Offerings
desc: Second pitch of 'Burnt Offerings'. All titanium bolts.

name: Playing with Fire

name: Project

name: Flame Thrower

name: Up in Smoke
desc: The orange pockety rock just left of 'Fire Show'. 3 titanium bolts, 6 slings.

name: Fire Show
desc: Stiff reachy boulder problem to get over the bulge at the start. Much easier afterwards. All titanium bolts.

name: Fire Show (Variation)
desc: Start variation, skipping the bold start by traversing to the right from 'Up in Smoke'.

name: Fire Starter
desc: Steep start on big holds through the overhang just right of 'Fire Show'. Crux on the headwall has become quite polished. 5 titanium bolts, 2 slings. Share anchor with White Hot Hernias.

name: White Hot Hernias
desc: Very polished on the crux, just after traversing left onto the wall. Stick-clip first bolt. 5 titanium bolts, 2 slings. Share anchor with Fire Starter.

name: For Helga
desc: Warning Rock: Be mindful of ledge! Nice long run. All titanium bolts.

name: Burning down the House
desc: Second pitch of 'For Helga'. Not rebolted. Old stainless steel glue-ins. Do not climb!

name: Boobtube
desc: Another great long line with a tricky 3D crux in the small roof. 7 titanium bolts, 5 slings.

name: The Groove Tube
desc: A must do! Climbs up the tube to the far right. Optional start through the hole. 4 titanium bolts and slings.

name: Polish-Czech
desc: Second pitch of 'The Groove Tube'. A few meters straight up from the belay ledge then traverse to the left. Rarely climbed and not rebolted with titanium. 2 stainless steel glue-ins, 7 slings, which might need replacement.
warnings: 2 stainless steel glue-ins, 7 slings, which might need replacement.

name: Devil Cat
desc: Starts left of the main ledge. All titanium bolts.

name: The Cat and the Cobra
desc: Good warm-up. Starts left of the main ledge. 5 titanium bolts, 2 slings.

name: Kitty Porn
desc: Starts on the very left of the main ledge. Descend by rapping down three times with a 70m rope, backclipping the second pitch. Rebolted with titanium.

name: April Fools
desc: Awesome route, big holds, steep and pumpy. Soft for the grade. All titanium bolts.

name: Gilles No Limits
desc: 11 titanium bolts, 1 sling.

name: Black Cat
desc: Rebolted with titanium.

name: King Cat
desc: Must do! Exposed and absolutly great pockets. Belaying and cleaning is a challenge but absolutly worth it! 2 titanium bolts, 7 slings.

name: Queen Cat
desc: Second pitch of 'Peyote'. Can also be accessed by climbing 'King Cat'. All titanium bolts.

name: Peyote
desc: Starts right below the main ledge, between the fixed rope and a tree. Rebolted with titanium. 2nd pitch share anchor with Road to Damascus.

name: Road to Damascus
desc: Be aware that lowering from the anchor requires an extra 20m to reach the ground! 11 titanium bolts, 1 sling. Share anchor with 2nd pitch of Peyote.

name: Hot Tin Roof
desc: All titanium bolts.

name: Musang
desc: Musang means "civet cat" in Thai. Rappelling this route is difficult. Take 15 quickdraws. Rebolted with titanium.

name: The Ninth Life
desc: Closed Due to fire in the past, the rock is very unstable here and stones pop off and fall down every other day. Therefore, the route will not be rebolted again.
warnings: Closed Due to fire in the past, the rock is very unstable here and stones pop off and fall down every other day.

name: Project
desc: Closed Started from the first anchor of 'The Ninth Life'.
warnings: Closed Started from the first anchor of 'The Ninth Life'.

name: Indian Food
desc: Here and there a little moss, but still good to climb. Dry during rain.

name: The Monitor
desc: First pitch gives access to a huge cave with multiple windows, from which all multi-pitch routes on the Monitor Wall start. Straight up from the ground to the first anchor at the bottom of the cave. From the anchor scramble up left for about 10m into the cave. Follow a fixed rope down the cave and turn left to a cave window, where the belay anchor for P2 is located. Facing out the cave, climb up left. Climb up the left side of the huge stalactite. Straight up to the anchor located in a cave. Bring two 60m ropes and leave the second rope at the abseil anchor next to the anchor of P2, which is located in a cave behind the huge stalactite. From there it's a 60m rap to the ground.
setter: Tom Cecil, Drew Spaulding & Mark Miner, 2001

name: Snake, Ganja & Rastaman
desc: Re-established after it had been recycled into 'The Monitor'. Starts to the right of 'The Monitor' with the former access pitch 'Just Climb'. Shares the upper two pitches with 'The Monitor'.

name: Shaft of Light
desc: Old rusty expansion bolts. Do not climb!
setter: Tom Cecil, Drew Spaulding & Mark Miner, 2001

name: Whipper Snapper
desc: Alternative second pitch of 'Shaft of Light'. Old rusty expansion bolts. Do not climb!
setter: Tom Cecil, Drew Spaulding & Mark Miner, 2001

name: Praying Mantis
desc: Great climbing. Access by climbing the first pitch of 'The Monitor'. Then scramble up and left into a big cave with multiple windows. Climb up right onto a ledge with two cave windows. Take the belay anchor on the right side of the right window. Facing out the cave, climb up right over a bulge. Climb up to the anchor behind the huge stalactite. Up on the other side of the stalactite. Bring two 60m ropes for rapping down. Fix the second rope at the belay anchor in the cave to pull yourself back when abseiling. Walk back through the cave and rappel from the belay anchor for the second pitch of 'The Monitor'.

name: Snakeskin
desc: Access by climbing the first pitch of 'The Monitor'. Scramble up and left into a big cave with multiple windows. Climb up right onto a ledge with two cave windows. Take the belay anchor on the right side of the right window. Facing out the cave, climb up left around the stalactite. Same as 'Monkey See, Monkey Do' P2. Traverse the big ledge to the right for three bolts. This is more a hike then climbing and can be linked with P1. Use the left anchor. Straight up. Rap down to the anchor of P1, while backclipping. Abseil into the cave. Walk through the cave to the belay anchor for P2 of 'The Monitor', from which you can rappel to the ground.
setter: Tom Cecil, Justin Day & Brian Cornwell, 2004

name: Monkey See, Monkey Do
desc: Could be the best multi pitch at the grade on the peninsular. Great climbing, especially on the upper pitches. Access by climbing the first pitch of 'The Monitor'. Then scramble up left into a big cave with multiple windows. Climb up right onto a ledge with two cave windows. Move down to the left side of the left window to find the belay anchor. Facing out the cave, left up onto a ledge. Same as 'Snakeskin' P2. Traverse the big ledge to the right for three bolts. This is more a hike then climbing and can be linked with P1. Use the left anchor. From the anchor head straight up through overhanging terrain over multiple ledges. End up in a hanging belay to the right of the huge stalactite feature. Follow 3 horizontal lined up bolts to another anchor onto the big stalactite. From here straight up through a crack onto the face. Enjoy the view but keep focused on the climb, it's mental. 15 quickdraws needed. Bring two 60m ropes to rap off. Fix the second rope at the anchor of P2 and use it to pull yourself back while abseiling (overhanging rock).
setter: Drew Spaulding, Justin Day, Jean & Noam, 2005

name: Stay Out
desc: After the first two pitches, stay left. Joins the upper half of the first pitch of 'Praying Mantis'.

name: Blind Monkey, Flat Monkey
desc: After the first two pitches, traverse right and continue straight up to the right end of the 'Mountaineering Ledge'. Then take the rightmost line for the final pitch.

name: Cave Sweeper
desc: Starts left of the upper pitches of 'Monkey See, Monkey Do' and climbs up to an anchor a bit below left of the anchor of MSMD, under a stalactite.

name: Frog's Hair
desc: Starts between the upper pitches of 'Monkey See, Monkey Do' and 'Blind Monkey, Flat Monkey'. Not rebolted. Do not climb!

name: Drunky
desc: Old slings. Do not climb!

name: Lost Cave
desc: Old slings and rusty old expansion bolts. Do not climb!

name: Egk Coming, Rit Going
desc: All slings, replaced 2019.

name: I Lost 10 Bhat
desc: Start on the left side of the cave. Rebolted 2019, 4 titanium bolts, 2 slings.

name: Chalk Walk
desc: Rebolted 2019, 2 titanium bolts, 3 slings.

name: Hin Kum
desc: Rebolted 2019, 1 titanium bolt, 3 slings.

name: Stranger Danger
desc: Shares the first pitch with 'Shoulda Woulda Coulda', with a separate anchor 2m to the left. Anchors of P2 are 2m left of the 'Cockblocker' P2 anchors. Titanium bolts and slings.

name: Cockblocker
desc: Shares the first pitch with 'Shoulda Woulda Coulda', with a separate anchor 2m to the left. Anchors of P2 are 2m left of the SWC P2 anchors. Titanium bolts and slings.

name: Shoulda Woulda Coulda
desc: New multi-pitch route left of 'Big Wave'. Very sharp rock in some of the easier sections. Not quite as good as 'Big Wave', but definitely a fun climb. Crux is the first two bolts, climbing up the vertical tufas. Second half is an easy but beautiful 3D climb through the stalactite system. 5 titanium bolts, 7 slings. Slabby start on sharp rock up to the crux over the bulge. 12 titanium bolts, 1 sling. Again, some sharp rock at the start. Easy climbing until the steep sustained crux of the route. A few more meters of vertical climbing on very sharp rock. 9 titanium bolts, 4 slings. Descend by rapping down the route. Three raps with a 60m rope. This route is so far only listed in the 2019 Pocket RockGUIDE as 'New Route 2019 Jan.'. If you have new information about grade and name, please update (bolts and slings are counted, Mar 2020).

name: Short Wave
desc: Closed Old route left of 'Big Wave' P2. Old expansion bolts seem to have been removed, and the route has been recycled into the new multi-pitch routes to the left.
warnings: Closed Old route left of 'Big Wave' P2.

name: Big Wave
desc: Shares the start pitch with 'The Beauty & the Beast', then climbs up left for three beautiful and homogeneous pitches. Start on the left side of the cave. Take the left of the two anchors. 7 titanium bolts. Climb a bit to the left and straight up. 8 titanium bolts. Straight up to an anchor in a cave. 8 titanium bolts. Short traverse to the left, then straight up. You will pass an additional anchor about midway. Lower the leader to this anchor to belay the second climber. 10 titanium bolts. From the midway anchor of P4 rap down four times with a 60m rope via a line of separate abseil anchors. WARNING store your bags at the restaurant, monkeys will go through your bag!

name: The Beauty & the Beast
desc: 3rd pitch is the beauty, 1st pitch is the beast. The second pitch just connects the two. The first pitch is shared with 'Big Wave'. Start with a couple of fun, overhanging moves out the left side of the cave, then easier climbing on sharp rock up the buttress. Take the right of the two anchors. 7 titanium bolts. Go up and sightly right - don't be lured by other bolts going further right. 9 titanium bolt. This pitch is fun and follows bolts up into a small ledge at a small cave. 12 titanium bolts. In 2006, Drew Spaulding and Adam Weiner established a 4th pitch, but it is not well equipped without trad gear. Climb up into the corner on gear, threads and a few bolts. Then tunnel up right and under the stalactite umbrella up to the bolted anchor (this pitch needs re-bolting). A wild ride! From the top of P3, it is also possible to traverse out left, wiggle through a hole in the cave, and finish up on the last pitch of 'Big Wave'. This finish slightly raises the grade, but dramatically increases the fun. Descend by rapping down three times from the anchor of P3 with a 60m rope.

name: Monkeying Around
desc: The leftmost of the three double-pitches starting from the lower belay ledge. In some guidebooks this pitch is named 'Barrel of Monkeys' and only the second pitch is called 'Monkeying Around'. 8 titanium bolts. 11 titanium bolts, 1 sling. Descend by rapping down twice with a 60m rope, back to the belay ledge.

name: Chunky Monkey
desc: Warning Flora and Fauna: Lianas blocking access to belay ledge The second line on the lower belay ledge. Great first pitch on steep rock with big holds. It is also possible to linkup the second pitch of 'Curious George'. 7 titanium bolts, 2 slings. 7 titanium bolts, 2 slings. Descend by rapping down twice with a 60m rope, back to the belay ledge. Share anchor with Curious George.
warnings: Flora and Fauna: Lianas blocking access to belay ledge

name: Curious George
desc: Warning Flora and Fauna: Covered with lianas The rightmost line on the lower belay ledge. Enjoyable double-pitch, especially the second pitch. 5 titanium bolts, 2 slings. 8 titanium bolts, 3 slings. Descend by rapping down twice with a 60m rope, back to the belay ledge. Share anchor with Chunky Monkey.
warnings: Flora and Fauna: Covered with lianas

name: Totem

name: Little Fish P1
desc: Certainly one of the most polished climbs in Ton Sai! Hard and pumpy for the grade. 5 titanium bolts, 1 sling.
setter: Tom Cecil, Mark Miner, Paul Turecki & Kirsten Kremer, 2001

desc: Old rusty expansion bolts. Do not climb until rebolted!

name: Hoes before Bros

name: Captain Crunch

name: Half Crunch

name: Let Some Steam Off
desc: Powerful climbing. All titanium bolts. Share anchor with 'Violently Happy' and 'Half Crunch'.

desc: Super! Hard start, even harder finish. 7 titanium bolts, 2 slings.

Starts up 'Straight out of Tonsai', branching right at its last bolt, then continuing straight all the way through the roof, finishing at its highest point, the anchors of 'Ninjas with Lasers'. Lots of climbing, lots of boulder problems, Open project. 23 titanium bolts, 3 slings.
